# Abhinav Karn

> Independent developer building AI systems, developer tools, web applications, and experimental software.

Abhinav Karn is an independent software developer interested in local-first AI systems, agentic automation, web development, and experimental engineering. All public projects are documented with source repositories on GitHub.

## Navigation & Core Pages

- [Home](https://abhinavkarn.in/): Primary introduction, selected projects, tools overview, and engineering philosophy.
- [Projects Directory](https://abhinavkarn.in/projects/): Complete directory of software projects, games, and research prototypes.
- [Developer Tools](https://abhinavkarn.in/tools/): Browser-based developer tools and automation utilities.
- [About](https://abhinavkarn.in/about/): Background, technical areas of focus, toolstack, and education record.
- [Contact](https://abhinavkarn.in/contact/): Verified direct communication channels and active hours.
- [Notes](https://abhinavkarn.in/notes/): Technical articles, build logs, and architecture documentation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://abhinavkarn.in/privacy-policy/): Technical transparency policy regarding hosting, Google Tag Manager, and cookies.

## Featured Projects

- [STONY AI Assistant](https://abhinavkarn.in/projects/stony-ai-assistant/): Local-first conversational AI companion with persistent memory and tool execution using Python and Ollama.
- [STARK Counter](https://abhinavkarn.in/projects/stark-counter/): Unified AI control center and developer cockpit consolidating multiple models and workflows.
- [Inspire MANAK Assist Vision](https://abhinavkarn.in/projects/inspire-manak/): Assistive computer vision prototype with embedded processing and wireless audio feedback for the visually impaired.
- [Kãl](https://abhinavkarn.in/projects/kal/): Atmospheric 2D psychological horror game prototype built with Blender asset workflows.
- [Neon Racer X](https://abhinavkarn.in/projects/neon-racer-x/): Fast-paced arcade racing game prototype exploring atmospheric track lighting and real-time physics.
